title: Multi-rater synaptic-punctum instance segmentation
current_best_explanation: No current global winner has been verified on this exact frozen input, split and scorer. A published dataset name or broad leaderboard lead is insufficient.
executed_endpoint: SynAPSeg 27 original 2D training fields, fixed 128-pixel crops with annotation-coverage masks; two whole benchmark images held out, each with five expert annotations. Primary equal-image/equal-rater instance F1, IoU ≥ 0.5, documented disconnected-ID and minimum-four-pixel cleanup. No animal-level independence established.

existing_reference.name: Author-deposited StarDist prediction masks rescored on the canonical two images
existing_reference.evidence: A: archived predictions verified on the custom multi-rater scorer.
existing_reference.strength: A real relevant punctum specialist, much stronger evidence than a generic nucleus segmentation rank.
problems: Historical benchmark exposure cannot be ruled out.
Training/selection effort and information differ from one-shot code.
Archived masks are a practical reference, not a newly trained pristine-test model or verified current best.
existing_reference.verification_scope: Only the named locally audited reference/archived outputs, not every newer candidate or equal-budget/global optimality.

candidates.name: Archived SynAPSeg 2D StarDist predictions
candidates.evidence: B/A: original punctum study plus local archived masks.
candidates.information_match: Deposited masks are already rescored on the local endpoint. Fresh train-field-only retraining is a separate unexecuted candidate.

candidates.name: SynAPSeg fine-tuned Cellpose-SAM
candidates.evidence: B: source study directly compares this punctum architecture.
candidates.information_match: Strongest immediate alternative: retrain only on allowed original training fields and masked annotation regions; do not use test-rater labels for tuning.

candidates.name: Cellpose-SAM v2 / CellposeDINO
candidates.evidence: C: current official releases, not matched punctum evidence.
candidates.information_match: Single-image input fits, but tiny puncta, sparse labels and scale need training-field validation.

candidates.name: CellSAM
candidates.evidence: B for whole-cell segmentation; C/D for puncta adaptation.
candidates.information_match: Whole-cell detector prior may miss tiny objects; no oracle bounding boxes permitted.

candidates.name: microSAM / DeepD3
candidates.evidence: B for microscopy or spines, not a proven punctum winner.
candidates.information_match: Automatic mask proposal can be evaluated; interactive prompts or spine-specific labels change information/target.

recommended_next_comparator: Fresh SynAPSeg-style StarDist and fine-tuned Cellpose-SAM, trained on exactly the existing 27 fields and chosen with training-field validation; add cpsam_v2/cpdino only as prespecified challengers.
switching_assessment: ADD a clean trained specialist arm, high priority, Tier B. Retain archived StarDist as historical rescoring. Source 2D comparison supports multiple contenders, not a unique winner; current generic cell-model releases do not establish a better punctum reference.
limitations: Two test fields cannot support a broad segmentation ranking.
Five raters are correlated annotations, not five specimens.
Ignore unknown training pixels in every neural loss and validation transform.
Published source benchmark aggregates and centroid-consensus scores differ from this custom multi-rater F1.
Generic SAM box/point prompts from hidden annotations would be unequal information.
All new candidate runs would require a separate compute and exposure declaration.

evidence_tiers.A: Locally executed and audited on this frozen protocol; establishes a comparator result, not universal optimality.
evidence_tiers.B: Primary method/benchmark with relevant task evidence but an unmatched split, inputs, scorer or budget.
evidence_tiers.C: Author repository, preprint, mathematical proposal or adaptation requiring additional validation.
evidence_tiers.D: Unresolved access, unavailable artifacts or input mismatch precludes an executable recommendation.

execution_policy: Literature review only. No inference, fitting, new scores, checkpoint downloads, frozen protocol edits or result changes. Any new comparator requires a prospective amendment, frozen training-only selection and separate result records.
score_import_policy: No unmatched published numbers were imported into benchmark scores.
